fields.place: Goyās (confluence of the Ganges and the Padmā); descendants at Saidābād
fields.notes: Elder son of the Śākta Śivāi (Śivānanda) Ācārya of Goyās and elder brother of Rāmakṛṣṇa Ācārya. Bringing goats home for the Durgā-pūjā sacrifice, the two brothers met Narottama Ṭhākura and Rāmacandra Kavirāja, let the animals go and fell at Narottama's feet; Rāmakṛṣṇa took dīkṣā from Narottama, Harirāma from Rāmacandra Kavirāja (Narottama-vilāsa 9-10, 17). Their angry father brought the paṇḍita Murāri of Mithilā to defeat them, but Balarāma Kavirāja defeated him (Narottama-vilāsa 10). Brought Gaṅgānārāyaṇa Cakravartī to Narottama. Praised in Bhakti-ratnākara 15 (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna, «Harirāma Ācārya»). Not the same as Harirāma Vyāsa of Oṛchā.

Of the branch of Narottama Ṭhākura. Youngest son of Rāmakṛṣṇa Ācārya and Kanakalatikā Devī, nephew of Harirāma Ācārya; adopted by Gaṅgānārāyaṇa Cakravartī, who had no son, and initiated by him (Narottama-vilāsa 12; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Guru of Rādhāramaṇa Cakravartī, in the line of Viśvanātha Cakravartī.

Sixth son of Śrī Advaita Ācārya and Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī, a branch of Advaita: «Advaita's other son Svarūpa, a branch named Jagadīśa» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 12.27). Twin of Svarūpa (Advaita-prakāśa 15; Prema-vilāsa 24), born in Jyaiṣṭha 1508 CE by those books, though Acyutānanda's age makes that year impossible.

Brothers: Acyutānanda, Kṛṣṇa Miśra, Gopāla Miśra, Balarāma Miśra, Svarūpa Ācārya. Not Jagadīśa Paṇḍita of Yaśaḍā.

Son of Śrī Advaita Ācārya and Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī: «Ācārya's other son Śrī Balarāma» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 12.27; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

Brothers: Acyutānanda, Kṛṣṇa Miśra, Gopāla Miśra, Svarūpa Ācārya, Jagadīśa Miśra.
